column2: Sure I am. I'm always toughening myself up like this, and traveling with you has toughened me up too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Yeah, I'll be careful. If I got hurt training, I'd be in no shape to fight.{wait}{clear}I won't do anything reckless.
What I watch most is my focus. If I can't focus, it feels like none of the training sinks in.
Yeah, it's going great.{wait}{clear}I feel ready for whenever a request comes from you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. So don't worry.

Yeah, that's what makes me happiest. But fighting and hurting people feels like a different thing...{wait}{clear}I never thought about it much before I set out, but I think you must never misuse your strength...
Not at all. Geez, you worry about me too much.{wait}{clear}I think you can stand your ground more and be a bit pushier.{wait}{clear}Well, maybe that's impossible for you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Hahaha...! Asking stuff like that is so like you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}What I like is napping and playing. Either I'm moving around or I'm asleep. Simple, I know.
Well, I think so. You'll forgive me for taking it easy between fights now and then, right...?

An abrupt question, just like you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Well, that's nothing new...{wait}{clear}When I was little... back when I didn't know anything, I played with my brother... and Mom was there too... It's a good memory from long ago now.
Sure. You must be tired too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, so you should rest a bit.
Yeah... I know... But if I'm worn out, I can't give it my all. It's fine to rest a little, right?
Thanks. You should rest too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Yeah, I guess. So much has happened that it's hard to sort it all out in my head.{wait}{clear}But I think I have to think it through. There's still time...

Well, once I left Fanlan I could act fairly freely, so I've been to crowded places.{wait}{clear}But inside Legrance, you never knew what might happen, so I was always on edge...{wait}{clear}Even now, anything could happen, but not being bound by rank or family makes it so much easier.{wait}{clear}So if you ask me, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'll go to crowded places.
Yeah, I'm eating fine. There's food you can't get in Legrance, so I really look forward to meals.{wait}{clear}Though some things only grow in Legrance, so sometimes something's missing.
Don't worry so much. I'm fine.
Yeah, I'm fine. I'll beat the enemy, you'll see.
Yeah... First, let's see how the enemy comes at us...
Yeah, I won't let my guard down. No matter the enemy.
No, there's no point worrying now that we're here. All that's left is to size up the enemy in battle.
Yeah, thanks. I'll beat the enemy, you'll see.
I appreciate the worry, but when you're like that, it makes ME worried.
I'm sure you'll be fine, Rudi.
Yeah... Thanks for saying so. But I don't plan on letting my guard down, so leave it to me.
Don't say it with such a miserable face... It's a bad omen.
I get how you feel, but calm down. You're making me nervous too.
This is... because I wasn't strong enough... Don't worry about it, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Come on, don't make such a fuss. It's embarrassing...
Don't thank me. Losing doesn't exactly look cool...
No, don't worry about it... It's because I wasn't strong enough.
No, I'm fine, so don't worry.
It's not your fault, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. If only I were stronger...{wait}{clear}So please don't apologize.
No, I don't mind being relied on... I'm just ashamed I couldn't live up to it.{wait}{clear}But I'll make this a good lesson and get stronger.
No... I just couldn't size up the enemy. It really drove home how weak I am...{wait}{clear}I need to hone my skills more, much more... more...
